Rachel (CS): Kicking off Springboard onboarding here. Top priorities: sandbox + VPC peering, SSO/KMS, and an E2E chat smoke test within 14 days. Who owns what?
Evan (CSM): I can own stakeholder comms and success criteria. Suggest weekly 25-min sync Wed 9:30am PT.
Miro (Springboard): Hi all 12 Miro from Springboard. Our launch calendar is tight; legal will likely ask about audit retention and export. We also need an SRE enablement after integration.
Priya (Solutions): I'll be technical lead. Need sample payloads, expected QPS (p95 spikes), and whether you'll use embeddings or generation primarily.
Sam (Security): I'll run the security questionnaire. If they require >90d log retention, we might need legal review. Any PII expected in prompts?
Miro (Springboard): No PII. SSO contact: idp-admin@springboard.io. We'll upload a 2-min sample convo and CIDR by EOD.
Rachel (CS): Owners assigned: Evan -> comms & renewal watch; Priya -> integration lead; Sam -> security sign-off; Rachel -> milestones/runbook. Miro -> provide artifacts + SRE contact.
Priya (Solutions): Proposed timeline:
Day 0: Kickoff + collect SSO/KMS/CIDR
Day 2: Sandbox provisioning + peering attempt + smoke auth
Day 6: E2E test + perf baseline
Day 10: Observability + dashboard seed + runbook draft
Day 14: Enablement + customer sign-off
Evan (CSM): Success criteria (draft): authenticated calls from Springboard sandbox; E2E test passes with p95 latency < target; dashboard shows cost per convo below threshold; recorded enablement + playbook delivered.
Sam (Security): Risk note: if security questionnaire requires segmentation changes, flag renewal risk if sign-off slips beyond 10 days. Also firewall windows often add 48-72h.
Miro (Springboard): We'll aim to share artifacts by EOD. SRE lead is @katie (katie@springboard.io).
onboard-bot: Meeting created: "Springboard Onboarding Deep Dive" tomorrow 11:00am PT 6 invite sent. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood-internal/meet/springboard-onboard
Rachel (CS): Quick ask: can Priya + Miro attend a 45-min technical deep-dive tomorrow to walk SSO, KMS, and sample payloads?
Priya (Solutions): Yes. Pre-reqs: SAML metadata or OIDC issuer URL; sample request/response; CIDR and QPS estimate.
Miro (Springboard): Will send all items by EOD.
Evan (CSM): I'll add renewal checkpoints (90/60/30/14) in CRM and set a renewal-watch flag if security extends beyond 10 days.
Rachel (CS): Next steps: 1) Miro uploads artifacts (EOD), 2) Priya drafts test plan, 3) Sam pre-reads security questionnaire. Reconvene after deep-dive to lock Week 1 tasks. If any blocker, drop updates here. :rocket:
